current_answer: UKRI’s Transformative sustainable AI technologies grant is open until 10 November 2026 at 16:00 UK time. It welcomes individuals and research groups, but an individual must lead from a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding and meet the individual eligibility rules. A project may have full economic cost up to GBP 602,500, with UKRI funding 80%; this is a restricted research-project route, not a personal grant. The individual catalogue now has two distinctly constrained cash-project routes: UKRI for UK-hosted sustainable-AI research and NLnet for eligible open-technology work.

catalogue_card.question: Can an individual apply for this UK AI grant?
catalogue_card.text: Yes, but only through an eligible UK research organisation. The sustainable-AI call closes 10 November 2026; its GBP 602,500 project-cost cap is not a personal grant cheque.

summary: UKRI’s Transformative sustainable AI technologies opportunity is open until 10 November 2026 at 16:00 UK time.
It welcomes research groups and individuals, but a project lead must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding and meet individual eligibility rules.
The maximum project full economic cost is GBP 602,500; UKRI funds 80% of that cost.
This is a sustainable-AI research project route, not general personal funding or an unrestricted startup grant.
NLnet remains the other individual cash-project route in this young catalogue; cloud and startup-credit routes remain separate decisions.
